files.source.svg: SVG extracted from the published PDF (PyMuPDF; text kept as <text>, fonts embedded)
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence three-layer stack where each band is boxed in its own accent colour and explicitly named, with the dashed dividers themselves labelled as named interfaces and a bottom legend defining solid-versus-dashed line meaning.
templates.what_to_learn: Name the dashed boundary line itself instead of leaving it a bare rule, give each of the 3-4 tiers its own accent colour tied to the tier's own name, and put a small solid/dashed legend below the figure when line style carries a data-versus-control meaning.
